Write Command
1) For single IP
connection

(+CIPMUX=0)
AT+CLPORT=<
mode>,<port>
2) For multi IP
connection
(+CIPMUX=1)
AT+CLPORT=<
n>,<mode>,<por
t>

Parameters: <n> 0..5 A numeric parameter which indicates the connection
number this used in multi IP connection
<mode> A string parameter which indicates the connection type
<port> 0-65535 A numeric parameter which indicates the local port
0 is default value, a port can be dynamically allocated a port.
This command will be effective when module is set as a Client
